text:
Houston tọrọ ntọala na Ọgọst 30, 1836 site n'aka ndị na-ere ala New York Augustus C. na John K. Allen n'akụkụ Buffalo Bayou. Ha kpọrọ ya aha dike Texas Revolution na onye isi ala Republic of Texas mgbe e mesịrị, General Sam Houston, na obodo nta ahụ jere ozi dị ka isi obodo Republic of Texas nwa oge.

Site na mmalite ndị ahụ dị n'akụkụ mmiri, Houston toro ruo n'ịbụ obodo nke anọ kachasị ibu na United States, ọnụọgụ ndị bi ya karịrị nde 2.3 na mpaghara ya karịrị nde 7. Ọ ghọrọ isi obodo ụwa nke ụlọ ọrụ ike na mmanụ na gas, ụlọ NASA Johnson Space Center — isi iyi nke aha ya, "Space City" — na Texas Medical Center. Ọ nọ n'etiti obodo ndị nwere ọtụtụ agbụrụ dị iche iche na America.

Ọdịiche ahụ na-akpụzi omenala bọọlụ obodo ahụ. Houston bụ ahịa bọọlụ siri ike, nke MLS Houston Dynamo FC na NWSL Houston Dash na-eduzi, ha abụọ na-egwu na Shell Energy Stadium. Nnukwu ndị Mexico-America na-anụ ọkụ n'obi mere obodo ahụ onye na-anabata Mexico national team, El Tri, na ihe omume CONCACAF. NRG Stadium — nke a maara ogologo oge dị ka Reliant Stadium — abụwo ebe United States na-anabata egwuregwu USMNT–Mexico, Gold Cup, na Copa América Centenario, na-adọta mmadụ 68,000 na karịa mgbe niile. Ọ bụ agụụ miri emi ahụ egosipụtara maka egwuregwu mba ụwa, yana ọnụọgụ na nleba anya zuru ụwa ọnụ nke obodo ahụ, na-eme ka Houston bụrụ ebe kwesịrị ekwesị n'etiti obodo ndị na-anabata 2026.
